info.title: Tasklore API
info.description: REST API of Tasklore. Browsers authenticate with the session cookie; scripts, the CLI and MCP clients with a personal access token (`Authorization: Bearer tl_pat_…`).

get.summary: Show version, runtime and database information
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Sign-in rules: session lifetimes and groups that must use two-factor sign-in
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

put.summary: Change the sign-in rules (TL-18)

delete.summary: End every session of a user
Remove a user’s two-factor sign-in, e.g. after a lost phone
delete.description:
If a group demands it, the person sets it up again at the next sign-in.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: List all users
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Create a local user
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: List all groups with their global permissions
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Create a group
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Add a user to a group
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group

get.summary: List custom fields, archived ones included
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Create a custom field
post.description:
Names are unique without regard to case and must not be a system field, TQL function or keyword.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

patch.summary: Change, archive or restore a custom field
patch.description:
Options are given as the full list; entries with an id are renamed or archived, entries without one are added, missing ones are archived.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Get the working time used for durations
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

put.summary: Change the working time used for durations
put.description:
Stored values stay in seconds; "1d" and "1w" are read and shown with the new lengths from now on.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: List the permission schemes with the projects using them
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Create a permission scheme as a copy of another (the default one if not given)
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Get a permission scheme with its grants
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

patch.summary: Rename a permission scheme or replace its grants

delete.summary: Delete a permission scheme no project uses

get.summary: List the issue security schemes with the projects using them
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Create an empty issue security scheme
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Get an issue security scheme with its levels
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

patch.summary: Rename an issue security scheme or replace its levels
patch.description:
Levels with an id keep it. Removing a level that issues still use answers 409, so no issue becomes visible to everyone by accident.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

delete.summary: Delete an issue security scheme no project uses

post.summary: Explain whether a person holds a permission on a project, issue, space or page
post.description:
The verdict and the facts behind it: roles, scheme grants, issue security, space roles and page restrictions.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: List the notification schemes with the projects using them
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Create a notification scheme as a copy of another (the default one if not given)
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Get a notification scheme with its rules
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

patch.summary: Rename a notification scheme or replace its rules

delete.summary: Delete a notification scheme no project uses

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Complete a sign-in with the code from the authenticator app or a recovery code
post.description: After a password sign-in whose `twoFactor.pending` is `verify` (TL-18, E-100).

post.summary: Sign out and end the current session

get.summary: List the sign-in methods this installation offers
List boards in projects the caller can see

post.summary: Create a board located in a project
post.description: Requires the permission `administer` in that project. Starts with one column per workflow status (E-53).

patch.summary: Configure a board: scope, columns, WIP limits, quick filters, swimlanes
patch.description: Columns and quick filters are given as full lists in display order.

delete.summary: Delete a board; its issues stay

get.summary: The board with its cards in rank order (at most 500)
get.description: `filters` narrows with quick filters: "mine", "recent" or ids of the board’s own, combined with AND.

post.summary: Move a card into a column and between two cards
post.description: Runs the workflow transition to the first status of the column the issue can reach (409 if none), then ranks it between `afterKey` and `beforeKey`.

get.summary: List dashboards the caller can see

post.summary: Create a dashboard
post.description: Sharing requires the global permission `share-filters`.

post.description: Sharing requires the global permission `share-filters`.

get.summary: Get a saved filter

delete.summary: Delete a saved filter (owner or administrator)

put.summary: Mark a filter as favourite

delete.summary: Remove a filter from the favourites

get.summary: Liveness: the process is running
Readiness: the database is reachable
List the attachments of an issue

post.summary: Attach a file to an issue
post.description: multipart/form-data with the file in the field `file`; needs the project permission `comment`. The size limit is `attachmentMaxBytes` from /tracking/meta.

delete.summary: Delete an attachment (own, or any as project administrator)

get.summary: Download the content of an attachment
get.description: Verified raster images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) are served inline unless `download=1`; everything else always as a download.

get.summary: List issue types, statuses, priorities, resolutions and link types

post.summary: Look up issues by key, for live links
post.description: Up to 200 keys; answers only issues the caller may see. Unknown and hidden keys are both left out.

post.summary: Create an issue

get.summary: Get an issue by key

patch.summary: Change fields of an issue; every change is recorded in its history

delete.summary: Delete an issue with its subtasks

get.summary: List the workflow transitions available from the current status

post.summary: Move an issue to another status

put.summary: Rank an issue between two others
put.description: The rank is global: the order is the same on every board and backlog (T-BRD-10). Needs `edit-issues`.

get.summary: List the comments of an issue

post.summary: Add a comment to an issue

get.summary: List the change history of an issue, newest first

put.summary: Watch an issue

delete.summary: Stop watching an issue
Delete a comment (own, or any as project administrator)

post.summary: Link the issue to another issue
post.description: Requires `edit-issues` on this issue and browse access to the other one.

delete.summary: Remove a link

get.summary: List the work logged on an issue, newest first

post.summary: Log work on an issue
post.description: Needs `edit-issues`. Durations like "1d 4h" use the instance’s working time (`workingTime` in /tracking/meta). The remaining estimate drops by the logged time unless `remaining` says otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a worklog (own, or any as project administrator)

get.summary: Wiki pages that refer to an issue
get.description: Published pages whose latest version names the issue key or embeds it as a macro, only in spaces the caller may view; newest first.

post.summary: Change many issues at once
post.description: Edit, transition, move to a sprint, delete, watch or unwatch. Each issue goes through the same checks as a single change; the result lists which failed and why.

post.summary: Copy an issue
post.description: Copies fields, custom fields and the security level, links the copy to the original ("clones"), and optionally the subtasks. Needs create-issues.

post.summary: Move an issue with its subtasks to another project
post.description: New keys, the old ones keep working. Type and status are kept where the target allows, else mapped (same category, else initial); components and versions by name; security level kept or the target default. Needs edit-issues in the source and create-issues in the target.

get.summary: Get the signed-in user

patch.summary: Change name, language, time zone or shortcut setting of the signed-in user

post.summary: Start setting up two-factor sign-in: a secret for the authenticator app
Turn two-factor sign-in on with a first code; returns recovery codes once
Turn two-factor sign-in off with a valid code
Replace the recovery codes; needs a valid code

delete.summary: End all other sessions of the signed-in user

get.summary: List the signed-in user’s active sessions

post.summary: Change the own password; other sessions end
post.description: Needs the current password and a browser session. Failures count against the same limit as the login (429 when exceeded); accounts without a local password get 409. Personal access tokens stay valid.

delete.summary: End one of the signed-in user’s sessions

get.summary: List the signed-in user’s personal access tokens

post.summary: Create a personal access token; the secret is returned only once

delete.summary: Revoke a personal access token

post.summary: Finish the welcome steps after the first sign-in
post.description: Saves the profile and, with `start`, creates in one go: Scrum or Kanban → project, board and a linked Lore space with a start page; Lore → only the space. Without `start` the steps count as skipped. Web sessions only.

get.summary: List the caller’s notifications, newest first
Count unread notifications
get.description: Cheap enough to poll; the web app asks every 30 seconds and on focus (E-44).

post.summary: Mark notifications as read

get.summary: Get the caller’s notification settings

put.summary: Change the caller’s notification settings

get.summary: List the pages with a label
get.description: In every space the caller can see, or only in `space`; sorted by title.

get.summary: List the attachments of a page

post.summary: Attach a file to a page
post.description: multipart/form-data with the file in the field `file`; needs the space permission `edit`. Images in the page text refer to attachments by id.

delete.summary: Delete a page attachment (own, or any as space administrator)

get.summary: Download the content of a page attachment
get.description: Verified raster images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) are served inline unless `download=1`; everything else always as a download.

get.summary: List the comments of a page
get.description: Page comments and inline threads, oldest first; answers carry `parentId`, inline threads an `anchor` on the published text.

post.summary: Comment on a page, answer a thread or start an inline thread
post.description: Requires the space permission `comment`. `body` is a document or `{ markdown }`.

delete.summary: Delete a page comment (own, or any as space administrator)

put.summary: Resolve an inline thread

delete.summary: Reopen a resolved inline thread

get.summary: Get a page: its latest published version
get.description: Drafts have `version` 0 and no content. `?format=markdown` returns the content as Markdown.

patch.summary: Rename a page; links keep working

delete.summary: Move a page and the pages below it to the trash

post.summary: Move a page in its space’s tree
post.description: Under `parentId` (null: top level), before the sibling `beforeId` or last.

post.summary: Publish a page as its next version
post.description: Stores the given document (usually the live draft) as an immutable version. The document must fit the editor schema.

get.summary: The published versions of a page, newest first
One published version of a page

put.summary: Set the labels of a page
put.description: Replaces all labels; they are lower-cased and not part of the versions. Requires the space permission `edit`.

get.summary: Who may see and edit the page (TL-14)

put.summary: Limit who may see and edit the page
put.description: Replaces both lists; empty lists lift the restriction. View lists also cover every page below, edit lists only this page. Needs edit on the page; whoever sets a list stays in it (E-95).

put.summary: Watch a page, or the page with every page below it

delete.summary: Stop watching a page

get.summary: Compare two published versions of a page
get.description: Blocks (headings, paragraphs, list and task items, table rows, images, …) of `to` against `from`: unchanged, added, removed, or changed with the changed words.

post.summary: Restore an older version
post.description: Publishes the content and title of the version again as the newest version; the live draft follows, also in open editors. Requires the space permission `edit`.

post.summary: Restore a page from the trash

get.summary: List the caller’s favourites
get.description: Projects, saved filters, spaces and pages; items the caller can no longer see are left out.

put.summary: Star a project or space (key), or a saved filter or page (id)

delete.summary: Remove a favourite

post.summary: Remember that the caller opened an issue, project, space or page
post.description: Sent by the web app when a page opens; scripts normally do not call it (E-46).

get.summary: List recently opened issues, projects, spaces and pages, newest first
Get the caller’s columns for issue result lists
get.description: Key and summary are always shown; these are the further columns, in order.

put.summary: Choose the caller’s columns for issue result lists

get.summary: Activity stream: new issues, changes and comments, newest first
get.description: Optionally for one project or one person; page with `before` = `next`.

put.summary: Give the project a permission scheme; null for the default one
put.description:
Requires the global permission `admin` (E-82).

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: List the role assignments of a project
get.description: People and groups per project role. Requires the project permission `administer`.

post.summary: Give a user or group a role in a project

delete.summary: Remove a role assignment; the last administrator stays

get.summary: List the projects the caller can see

post.summary: Create a project from a template
post.description: Requires the global permission `create-projects`. The creator becomes project administrator.

get.summary: Get a project with its issue types, statuses and the caller’s permissions
List the issues of a project in rank order
Epics with their children and milestones for the timeline
get.description: Bars use the start and due date; without them, epics cover their children and children their latest sprint (`derived`). Milestones are versions with a release date.

get.summary: Find people who can work in the project
get.description: For assignees and @-mentions: active users who may browse the project. Needs no global `browse-users`.

get.summary: List the components of a project

post.summary: Create a component
post.description: Requires the project permission `administer`.

delete.summary: Delete a component; issues lose it

get.summary: List the versions of a project (unreleased first)

post.summary: Create a version
post.description: Requires the project permission `administer` (E-57).

patch.summary: Change, archive or unrelease a version

delete.summary: Delete an unused version (used ones are archived)

post.summary: Release a version
post.description: Sets the release date (default today); `moveOpenTo` moves unfinished issues to another unreleased version (T-REL-03).

put.summary: Choose the custom fields a project uses, in display order
put.description: Requires the project permission `administer`. Values of fields switched off stay stored but are hidden (E-50). `settings` makes fields required, hidden from forms, or gives them help text (TL-12); a field cannot be both required and hidden.

put.summary: Give the project an issue security scheme, or none
put.description:
Requires the global permission `admin` (E-94). Answers 409 while issues use levels the new scheme lacks.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

put.summary: Give the project a notification scheme; null for the default one
put.description:
Requires the global permission `admin` (E-83).

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Velocity: committed against completed for the last closed sprints
Burndown of a started sprint: one step per event (E-56)
Sprint report: completed, not completed, removed; added after start is marked

post.summary: Count issues of a TQL query by one or two fields
Issues created and resolved per day for a TQL query
Search issues with TQL
post.description: Runs a TQL query over the projects the caller can browse. An invalid query answers 400 with `queryErrors` (code, message and position of each error).

get.summary: Search issues, Lore pages, projects and spaces
get.description: Full text in German and English over what the caller may see; the last word also matches as a prefix, quotes, OR and -word work as in web search. Pages are searched in their latest published version, with a snippet whose hits are marked. `counts` always cover every kind.

get.summary: Suggest stored values for a TQL field
get.description: For autocompletion: `value` is the canonical text to put into the query.

get.summary: Report whether first-run setup is still required

post.summary: Create the first administrator with the setup code and sign in

get.summary: List the restricted pages of a space
get.description: Needs the space permission `administer`; lists pages even where the administrator cannot see them.

delete.summary: Lift all restrictions of a page
delete.description: Needs the space permission `administer`, not access to the page itself.

get.summary: List the spaces linked with a project
get.description: Only spaces the caller can see; a space is linked with at most one project.

get.summary: Find people who can see a space
get.description: For @-mentions in page comments; needs no global `browse-users`.

get.summary: List the spaces the caller can see

post.summary: Create a space
post.description: Requires the global permission `create-spaces`. The creator administers the space; all signed-in users may edit it.

get.summary: Get a space with the caller’s permissions

patch.summary: Change a space’s name, description, home page or project
patch.description: Requires the space permission `administer`; linking or unlinking a project also requires `administer` on that project.

get.summary: List the labels used in a space
get.description: With the number of pages the caller can see that carry each label.

put.summary: Watch everything in a space

delete.summary: Stop watching a space

get.summary: List the role assignments of a space
get.description: Requires the space permission `administer`.

post.summary: Give a user or group a role in a space

delete.summary: Remove a role assignment; the last administrator stays

get.summary: The space’s page tree in order
get.description: A flat list in depth-first order; nest it by `parentId`. Drafts that were never published appear for editors only.

post.summary: Create a page as a draft
post.description: Requires the space permission `edit`. The page is visible to readers after its first publish.

get.summary: Pages in the space’s trash
get.description: Each entry was deleted on its own; pages below it come back with it.

get.summary: The backlog of a Scrum board: open sprints with their issues, then the rest
List the sprints of a board

post.summary: Plan a new sprint on a Scrum board

patch.summary: Change name, goal or dates of a sprint

delete.summary: Delete a planned sprint; its issues go to the backlog

post.summary: Start a planned sprint
post.description: One sprint runs per board. The estimates at this moment are the commitment.

post.summary: Complete the running sprint
post.description: Unfinished issues go to the backlog, a new sprint (`"new"`) or a planned sprint (its id).

post.summary: Move issues into a sprint or (sprintId null) to the backlog
post.description: Each issue leaves its current open sprint; the change is in its history.

get.summary: Templates offered when creating a page in a space
get.description: Blueprints first, then the space’s own templates, then global ones.

post.summary: Create a template of a space
post.description: Needs the space administration.

get.summary: Blueprints and global templates

post.summary: Create a global template
post.description: Needs the global permission "admin".

get.summary: Get a template or blueprint with its content
get.description: Takes a template id or `blueprint:<key>`.

put.summary: Change a template

delete.summary: Delete a template

get.summary: Find active users by name or email
get.description:
Requires the global permission `browse-users`.

Requires the global permission `browse-users`.

get.description:
For granting roles; requires the global permission `browse-users`.

Requires the global permission `browse-users`.

get.summary: List webhooks
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Create a webhook
post.description:
Deliveries are signed per Standard Webhooks (headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`). The secret is only returned here and when rotated.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Get a webhook
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

patch.description:
Enabling a webhook the system switched off also clears its failure state.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

delete.summary: Delete a webhook and its delivery log

post.summary: Replace the signing secret
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Send a test message now
post.description:
Returns the delivery with the receiver’s answer.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: List recent deliveries of a webhook (kept 30 days)
get.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Send a delivery again now
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: The project's workflow for the editor
get.description: Statuses in order, the initial status, allowed moves and how many issues use each status. With `issueType`, the workflow of that issue type: its own, or the standard one it uses (`inherited`).

post.summary: Publish a new version of the project workflow
post.description: Needs project administration. The first edit gives the project its own copy of a shared workflow; with `issueType`, the first edit gives that issue type a workflow of its own. The issues it applies to move to the new version; issues on removed statuses take the status given in `migrate` (history entry, no notifications); boards of the project adjust their columns. Answers 409 when `baseVersionId` is no longer current.

put.summary: Save the shared draft of a workflow
put.description: Needs project administration. One draft per project and issue type (`issueType`, else the standard workflow), shared by its administrators; publishing removes it (TL-77).

delete.summary: Discard the draft of a workflow
Let an issue type use the standard workflow again
delete.description: Needs project administration. Issues of the type keep their status where the standard workflow has it, else take the first status of the same category or the initial status (history entry, no notifications).
